title: Understanding Bag-of-Words Encoding
text: Bag-of-words is a technique often used in text processing. It involves representing text data as a set of words, disregarding grammar and word order. Think about whether this method is suitable for numerical data like age.

title: Evaluating Bag-of-Words for Age
text: Consider the nature of age as a numerical feature. Would converting it into a set of words capture its quantitative aspect?
